text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Did you not get enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Actually... there's an overseas race
that I just can't afford to miss.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There's a time difference between Japan and here, so...
the livestream inevitably ends up in the middle of the night...
*yawn*...
choice_data_list: You wanted to see it live, huh...
You wanted to see it live, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...! If it's for that kind of thrill, a little sleepiness is nothing... *yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Chrono Genesis wasn't able to get much rest...
